title: Asset Identity Map
description: Entity model for the CAMARA private-asset profile. An asset is a tracked physical thing (tool, pallet, forklift, robot), not a cellular subscriber: it has no MSISDN, IMSI or NAI. An asset holds an identity the organisation chooses and one or more positioning capabilities. Each capability names a source and the id that source knows the thing by. The gateway resolves a CAMARA `device.assetId` to one entry, asks the engine for the position of every capability, and fuses the answers into one fix. Written over GET/PUT /assets on the camara-gateway, which persists it. See docs/asset-registry.md.

version.description: Asset Identity Map schema version. Pinned in schema/VERSION.

kind.description: Asset class, surfaced as profile `kind`. PUT /assets accepts a kind that a registered adapter advertises, or one the stored map already uses.

org.description: Tenant. The gateway joins this against the token `org` claim (2-legged enterprise auth) so a consumer sees only its tenant's assets.

capabilities.description: The positioning capabilities of the asset. Several entries are fused by the gateway into one fix.

assetId.description: First-class CAMARA identifier (device.assetId). A business id chosen by the enterprise (e.g. pkg-4471, forklift-7). NOT a phone number.

capability.description: One way the asset is positioned: a source and the id that source knows the asset by.

source.description: The adapter that serves this capability, by the name it registers under. PUT /assets accepts a source a registered adapter serves, or one the stored map already uses.

positioningId.description: The id this source routes on (engine polls the adapter for `source` with this id). Distinct per source: the same asset is a different id to WiFi than to UWB.
